legacy_bundle.reason: Shared-base lineage and insufficient identity overlap with the final side-local 31/8 top-40 population.

calendar.april: development warm-up for side-local feature selection and HPO; no residual OOF performance claim
calendar.may: first residual OOF fold; train only prior April identities whose labels resolved before 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z
calendar.june: second residual OOF fold; train only prior April-May identities whose labels resolved before 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z
calendar.july_1_10: third residual OOF fold; train only prior April-June identities whose labels resolved before 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z
calendar.april_output_policy: explicit base_passthrough_warmup or excluded; never presented as residual OOF

side_local_invariants.final_refit: independent long and short and excluded from OOF metrics

target.residual_definition: observed cost-aware net capture minus train-only side-local baseline expected EV
target.cost_policy: already net of the fixed 1% round-trip cost; do not subtract cost again

features.allowed: causal point-in-time raw features, matching frozen side-local AE/GMM outputs, base OOF prediction, and ranks/margins recomputed from the canonical side stream
features.forbidden: realized first-touch/path outcomes, old shared residual/meta predictions, outcome-generated archetypes, or opposite-side fitted state

resource_contract.process_order: one side and one fold at a time
resource_contract.staging_policy: atomic publish; remove failed staging directories

promotion_gate: On exact May-July OOF rows, corrected residual EV must improve the matching side-local base EV on the cost-aware objective and preserve acceptable month stability; otherwise retain base passthrough for that side.
